worth the wait.
settings.copy: The Riot Room is a 180-seat comedy club in a converted music-hall basement — where established headliners test new material and first-timers find out if they're funny. We serve cheap pints and even cheaper laughs.

trust_list.text: 180 seats — no bad sightline, no bad seat
Three comics a night, six nights a week
Open mic every Sunday — sign-up at the bar

stats.label: Seats, every one with a clear view of the stage
Shows a week, from amateur night to touring headliners
Comics who've worked this room, from open mic to the big tours
Years of hosting the city's best (and worst) jokes

settings.title: Who's on
settings.intro: Every week we mix touring headliners, hot new acts, and the local regulars who've been sharpening their sets in this basement for years.

features.title: Headliner nights — Thu to Sat
features.text: Touring headliners working fresh material in an intimate room. Expect a full hour, a packed stage, and zero phones on the floor.

features.title: Midweek showcase
features.text: Three rising comics, one strong MC, and a bar that stays open late. The best-value night in the city if you know where to look.

features.title: Sketch & improv night
features.text: Our resident troupe plus a rotating cast of guests. Half-scripted, half-chaos, entirely worth the cover.

features.title: Sunday open mic
features.text: The room where it starts. Five minutes, a stool, and a mic that's seen it all. Sign up at the bar from 7pm.

features.title: Comedy quiz night
features.text: Teams of four, one very opinionated quizmaster, and a tie-breaker decided entirely by whoever's funniest. Not to be missed.

features.title: The Riot Late Show
features.text: A midnight special with a mystery headliner announced on the night. Past guests have ranged from national names to a very confident parrot.

settings.title: The Riot 38th Anniversary
settings.expired_text: The anniversary show is on — get your table before it sells out.

settings.title: What the room
settings.intro: From comics who worked the mic to regulars who never miss a Thursday — here's what they say about the Riot Room.

reviews.quote: The first room that ever gave me five minutes. The crowd is sharp, they're generous, and they'll absolutely let you know if it's not landing. The best education in stand-up I ever had.
reviews.author: D. Okafor

reviews.quote: We came for a birthday and left having laughed so hard my face hurt. The intimacy is unreal — you're ten feet from the stage and the jokes hit harder because of it.
reviews.author: L. Bennett

reviews.quote: I've booked comics into rooms all over the country and this is one of the best-run, best-sounding clubs there is. The crowd here actually wants to be won over, which is everything.
reviews.author: M. Reyes

settings.title: Book a table or
settings.intro: Want a table for six, a corner for two, or a slot on the open mic? Tell us what you need and we'll sort the rest.
